message:
Switch to cookie-only auth delegation (no per-app JWT mint)

Replaces the mint-and-store-JWT pattern with cookie-only delegation.
auth.romaine.life owns the session via a .romaine.life-scoped cookie that
the browser auto-attaches on every request to workout.romaine.life.
Backend forwards the cookie to auth.romaine.life's get-session endpoint
on each request (cached 60s) and gates on the returned role claim.

Reasoning
---------
Tank-operator mints + stores a session JWT because it bundles per-user
profile data (github_login, installation_id, run_prefs) into the token,
making every read self-contained. Kill-me has no equivalent — it just
re-signed the same {sub, email, name, role} that auth.romaine.life
already issued. That extra mint added per-app KV secret + role
assignments + a localStorage token, none of which paid for themselves.

Per tank-operator/docs/quality-timeframes.md "the durable data model or
state ownership is explicit" and "local UI state that can contradict
durable state" — auth.romaine.life is the durable owner; the localStorage
JWT was shadow state with TTL drift.

This also resolves the prod-503 state: pod no longer reads
kill-me-jwt-signing-secret, so the workload-identity-scope-on-renamed-
secret problem (blocked by the kill-me tfstate lock) is moot.

End-to-end deletions
--------------------
- backend/auth-routes.js (no /api/auth/exchange, no /api/auth/logout)
- backend/auth.js HS256 verifier + jose-based JWKS verifier; replaced
  with a cookie-forward middleware
- backend/config.js KV secret read (cosmos_db_endpoint is the only thing
  left to fetch)
- backend/package.json: dropped jose + jsonwebtoken
- frontend/src/auth/index.js: dropped fetchUpstreamJWT, exchange(),
  getStoredToken, clearStoredToken, all localStorage handling
- frontend/src/auth/AuthContext.jsx: dropped token state, just user/loading
- frontend/src/api/client.js: dropped Authorization header; uses
  credentials: 'include' so the .romaine.life cookie auto-attaches
- frontend/src/api/snapshotContext.jsx: switched from `token` to `user`
  for live/snapshot routing
- tofu/keyvault.tf (entire file — no per-app signing secret)
- tofu/identity.tf: dropped azurerm_role_assignment.kill_me_kv_jwt_secret
- k8s/templates/serviceaccount.yaml comment updated

Guard
-----
scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs extended to block reintroduction of
jsonwebtoken, jose, jwt.sign/verify, createRemoteJWKSet,
/api/auth/exchange, localStorage 'token', and kill-me-jwt-signing-secret.

Tofu apply on merge will destroy the now-unused KV secret and the
role assignment. (Whether the kill-me state lock from prior runs has
expired remains to be seen — if apply fails on lock, force-unlock
needed once.)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Drop accidentally-committed backend lockfile (npm install side effect)

The backend has historically used `npm install --omit=dev` in the
Dockerfile (no `npm ci`), and committing the lockfile would change
the install semantics for future PRs. Removing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

issue.body:
## Summary

Mirrors [kill-me#36](https://github.com/nelsong6/kill-me/pull/36). auth.romaine.life owns the session via a \`.romaine.life\`-scoped cookie that the browser auto-attaches on every request to investing.romaine.life. Backend forwards the cookie to \`auth.romaine.life/api/auth/get-session\` per request (60s cache) and gates on the returned role claim.

Per [tank-operator/docs/quality-timeframes.md](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/blob/main/docs/quality-timeframes.md): auth.romaine.life is the durable owner of the session; a per-app HS256 JWT in localStorage is shadow state with TTL drift, justified only when the app bundles per-user data into the token (tank-operator does, investing doesn't).

Should also resolve the prod-503: pod was crash-looping on something in the old \`jose\`/\`jsonwebtoken\` startup path. The new code reaches fewer external dependencies during \`fetchConfig()\` (just App Config — KV gone) and the heavyweight crypto deps are out of the bundle entirely.

## End-to-end deletions

| Deleted | Why |
|---|---|
| \`backend/auth-routes.js\` | No \`/api/auth/exchange\`, no logout endpoint |
| \`backend/auth.js\` HS256 + jose verifier | Backend forwards cookie instead |
| \`backend/config.js\` KV read | No signing secret needed |
| \`jose\` + \`jsonwebtoken\` deps | Not used |
| \`backend/routes.js\` \`jwtSecret\` factory param | Removed from signature |
| \`frontend/auth.js\` token dance | localStorage / fetchUpstreamJWT / exchange — gone |
| \`frontend/script.js\` Bearer header | \`credentials: 'include'\` instead |
| \`tofu/keyvault.tf\` | No per-app signing secret to provision |
| \`tofu/identity.tf\` \`investing_kv_jwt_secret\` role assignment | Pod doesn't read KV |

## Notes

- The SA still annotates \`infra-shared-identity\` (de23a2e0...). Switching to \`investing-identity\` (defined in tofu/identity.tf) is a follow-up that needs the actual client_id pinned. infra-shared-identity has the Cosmos + App Config access the pod needs.
- Guard script extended to block reintroduction of \`jsonwebtoken\`, \`jose\`, \`jwt.sign\`/\`jwt.verify\`, \`createRemoteJWKSet\`, \`/api/auth/exchange\`, \`localStorage 'token'\`, \`investing-jwt-signing-secret\`.

## Test plan

- [x] \`node scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs\` clean
- [ ] After image rolls: \`curl https://investing.romaine.life/health\` → 200
- [ ] Sign in via auth.romaine.life → admin actions (CSV import) work with cookie

## Summary

Mirrors [kill-me#36](https://github.com/nelsong6/kill-me/pull/36) + [investing#17](https://github.com/nelsong6/investing/pull/17). auth.romaine.life owns the session via the `.romaine.life`-scoped cookie. The Go backend forwards the inbound Cookie header to auth.romaine.life's `/api/auth/get-session` per request (60s cache per cookie value) and gates on the role claim. The SPA holds no token; same-origin credentialled fetches automatically attach the cookie.

Per [tank-operator/docs/quality-timeframes.md](https://github.com/nelsong6/tank-operator/blob/main/docs/quality-timeframes.md): *"the durable data model or state ownership is explicit"* and *"local UI state that can contradict durable state"*. Verifying RS256 JWTs locally was an optimization that bought nothing for glimmung (no per-user profile data to bundle) and put a session secret in localStorage as shadow state.

## Pattern

- **Backend** ([internal/auth/cookie_delegate.go](internal/auth/cookie_delegate.go)): `CookieDelegate.Resolve(ctx, cookie)` forwards the cookie to `auth.romaine.life/api/auth/get-session`, parses the user, gates on `role ∈ {admin, user}`. 60s in-process TTL cache keyed by cookie value. K8s SA-token path unchanged.
- **Composite routing**: `CompositeAuthenticator.ResolveCaller(ctx, *http.Request)` dispatches on `Authorization: Bearer <K8s SA token>` → K8s arm, else → Cookie arm. Browser callers always go through the Cookie arm.
- **Frontend** ([frontend/src/auth.ts](frontend/src/auth.ts)): preserves existing exports (`initAuth/currentAccount/signIn/signOut/publicConfig/authedFetch`). `initAuth` now calls `/v1/auth/me` (backend) instead of `auth.romaine.life/api/auth/token` (upstream). `authedFetch` uses `credentials:'include'`; no Bearer header. `getIdToken` is gone (no token to fetch).

## Interface change

`AuthResolver.ResolveCaller(ctx, authorization string)` → `ResolveCaller(ctx, *http.Request)`. Same for `AdminAuthenticator.RequireAdmin`. The composite needs both headers (Authorization for K8s, Cookie for upstream session), so taking the full request is cleaner than two stringly-typed params. Updated all callers (server constructors + 6 test fakes).

## End-to-end deletions

| Deleted | Why |
|---|---|
| `internal/auth/romaine_life.go` + test | RS256-verify path retired |
| `frontend/src/auth.ts` getIdToken / token cache / `/api/auth/token` fetch | No token |
| Various test fakes' `string` auth parameter | Replaced by `*http.Request` |

## Guard

[scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs](scripts/check-removed-msal.mjs) extended to block: `RomaineLifeAuthenticator`, `NewRomaineLifeAuthenticator`, `auth.romaine.life/api/auth/jwks`, `auth.romaine.life/api/auth/token`, `createRemoteJWKSet`, `localStorage.*Item("token"`.
